newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Faulding agrees to buy Irish group.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Faulding agrees to buy Irish group.

text.p: Pharmaceuticals manufacturer F.H. Faulding and Co Ltd said on Friday it had reached agreement to acquire 100 percent of the issued share capital of Central Laboratories Ltd and Central Laboratories (Ireland) Ltd of Ireland and 86 percent of Central Homecare Ltd of the U.K..
Faulding said Central Laboratories Ltd distrubutes a wide range of phamaceuticals in Ireland, including Faulding injectible products which are manufactured in Australia.
Central Laboratories (Ireland) distributes a range of injectable drug delivery systems in Ireland and the U.K.

"The combined organisation is a profitable and well established operation with excellent pharmaceutical market shares," Faulding chief executive Ed Tweddell said in a statement. Combined annual turnover is about A$5.5 million.
Faulding said Central Homecare was established in 1994 as the home healthcare arm of the company, providing treatment to chronically ill patients in their own homes.
Financial details of the transactions were not disclosed.
